# User Profiles

## Problem

The system currently only tracks student email addresses, but more detailed information would be helpful for better management and personalization.

## Recommended Solution

Create comprehensive user profiles with:

- Full name (first name, last name)
- Email address
- Student ID number
- Grade/Year level
- Branch or major (if applicable)
- Gender (optional)
- Phone number (optional)
- Emergency contact information
- Profile picture (optional)
- Interests and bio

## Context

Having detailed student profiles will help teachers better understand participants, manage activities more effectively, and provide personalized recommendations. Profile data should be stored securely and students should be able to view and edit their own information.
